claims.title: Mean calibration: fixed unary facets, minimal-face selection and arbitrary-activity slice inference

quoted_fields.interface: Fixed original R with accepted effective global actual-SCC predicate, fixed dimension. Feasible binary rational m in CLOSED CONVEX HULL of the original class Gamma. Compile finite fixed-R candidate facet normals and all their possible fixed equality matrices once. Slice inference accepts ordinary positive rational activities and binary precisions plus an actual representative; minimal-face selection constructs that representative from the existing exact local mean witness. Variable A compilation has only a terminating, not polynomial, guarantee. Inference on an artificial reversible presentation preserves SAME species and factorial weights, not physical constrained paths or irreversible stationary kinetics.
